topography.project_purpose: Pangolin is a multichain decentralized exchange (DEX) that enables users to swap tokens, provide liquidity, and earn rewards through an automated market maker (AMM) model, with PNG as its governance token and staking/yield farming features. The contract and audit coverage in this brief should be treated as Avalanche-only unless non-Avalanche deployments are explicitly added to scope.
topography.relationship_narrative: The DEX Core generates fees that are collected by the FeeCollector and directed to the CommunityTreasury. Governance contracts control treasury spending and protocol parameters, while Staking and Rewards distribute PNG tokens to incentivize liquidity provision.
